scope: One owned existing SQLite depot initialized and populated by stock TrailBase v0.34.3, then stopped and reopened using the isolated exact-base private G1 prototype; NOT stock recovery behavior, deployment readiness, or G1 signoff

tests.name: stock TrailBase leaves a private pending identity in the existing depot for upgrade
assertions: Owned stock server initialized a clean depot; the actual local SMTP container was stopped.
Ordinary stock registration returned HTTP 424 and left one pending _user identity in the SQLite depot; session was not established.
The owned mail container was restored before server shutdown.

tests.name: private G1 prototype upgrades a real existing depot without replacing its pending identity
assertions: Stock TrailBase server stopped before the exact-patch-verified private binary opened the same depot and completed startup/migration.
The pending identity's ID, address and password hash matched exactly across the migration and before/after confirmation.
The prototype public verification-trigger route sent real mail; its link confirmed the same identity and login with the original password succeeded.

tests.name: private G1 prototype preserves a confirmed identity across a second server restart
assertions: The same owned depot was closed and opened a second time with the exact private binary after the successful stock-to-private upgrade.
The confirmed identity ID, email, null unverified address and password hash were unchanged after restart.
The original password still authenticated after the second restart.

tests.name: stock G1 backup restore recovers the original pending identity and schema after prototype migration
assertions: Stock TrailBase created and listed exactly one backup of the owned depot containing the original pending identity.
After prototype upgrade, real confirmation and repeat restart, the private server was stopped and the pinned stock CLI restored that backup.
Stock TrailBase started from the restored depot; the original pending identity ID/address/password hash returned exactly, and private migration index/trigger/history artifacts were absent.

limitations: One owned macOS SQLite depot with exactly one preexisting pending identity; no PostgreSQL backend or Linux/browser run.
One on-depot TrailBase CLI backup/restore cycle only; this does not establish off-host recovery, retention policy, corruption recovery, or production disaster-recovery readiness.
One successful stock-to-private migration followed by one private-to-private restart on this fixture; further restart cycles and production upgrade safety remain open.
Reservation-only candidate and stock/default SMTP recovery results are unchanged; this is a separate source prototype only.
The debug CLI reports stale build metadata from the shallow checkout; the private patch/base/file/submodule gate and binary SHA are separately recorded.
explicitNonClaims: No stock/default G1 recovery fix, release binary or deployment approval.
